pg_settings.name: autovacuum_max_workers
pg_settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously running autovacuum worker processes.

pg_settings.name: autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay
pg_settings.short_desc: Vacuum cost delay in milliseconds, for autovacuum.

pg_settings.name: autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit
pg_settings.short_desc: Vacuum cost amount available before napping, for autovacuum.

pg_settings.name: autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor
pg_settings.short_desc: Number of tuple updates or deletes prior to vacuum as a fraction of reltuples.

pg_settings.name: autovacuum_vacuum_threshold
pg_settings.short_desc: Minimum number of tuple updates or deletes prior to vacuum.

pg_settings.name: checkpoint_completion_target
pg_settings.short_desc: Time spent flushing dirty buffers during checkpoint, as fraction of checkpoint interval.

pg_settings.name: effective_cache_size
pg_settings.short_desc: Sets the planner's assumption about the total size of the data caches.

pg_settings.name: maintenance_work_mem
pg_settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum memory to be used for maintenance operations.

pg_settings.name: max_wal_size
pg_settings.short_desc: Sets the WAL size that triggers a checkpoint.

pg_settings.name: min_wal_size
pg_settings.short_desc: Sets the minimum size to shrink the WAL to.

pg_settings.name: random_page_cost
pg_settings.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of a nonsequentially fetched disk page.

pg_settings.name: seq_page_cost
pg_settings.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of a sequentially fetched disk page.

pg_settings.name: shared_buffers
pg_settings.short_desc: Sets the number of shared memory buffers used by the server.

pg_settings.name: wal_buffers
pg_settings.short_desc: Sets the number of disk-page buffers in shared memory for WAL.

pg_settings.name: work_mem
pg_settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum memory to be used for query workspaces.
